A '''tax''' was levied by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Gladean]] of the [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrilan]] city of [[Emita/Legends|Emita]] on industrial manufacturing. The tax was calculated using a complex formula, and the revenue it generated was used to fund the [[Gladean State Parks]].<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
